name: public-blind-relay R-5: same-NAT peers connect through the default relay (committed harness scripts/relay/drill, defaults arm)
summary: Re-run of the R-5 live drill from the committed harness (scripts/relay/drill/run.sh + netns.sh + peer.mts, ported from the scratch relaydrill harness used at 16:22Z). Two peers in separate network namespaces behind the tower's one public IP with no route between them, joined to one hyperswarm topic through the shipped sync-relay module (resolveSyncRelayKeys(syncRelayKeyReader(undefined))). Both arms unset PAPERCUSP_VOICE_RELAY_KEYS. Control arm PAPERCUSP_RELAY_DEFAULTS=0: no relay key, never connects. Defaults arm PAPERCUSP_RELAY_DEFAULTS=1: the shipped default key b1015b56 is used and both peers record a relayed connection through the e2-micro relay. Plan public-blind-relay-2026-10-01 clause AUTO-BAR-R-5-P-004. Per-arm JSONL: .papercusp/scratch/relaydrill/out-committed/.
